notes: P4e22e070e6 G4: 'That player shuffles, then creates a 2/2 black Zombie creature token': the TARGET OPPONENT creates (and controls) the Zombie. Massacre Wurm then enters under you: creatures your opponents control get -2/-2, so the opponent's 2/2 Zombie dies and that player loses 2 life (Wurm's second ability). Were the Zombie yours, it would survive and nobody would lose life. 2026-11-12: "any number of" is asked pick by pick with a NONE stop (CR 107.1c); the pack picks every card it expects moved (a cast step's resolution asks read handles).
